value.name: Asha withholds her reaction
value.description: Asha stays still and watches Devin without giving him any visible cue or emotional signal.
evidence: Asha kept her weight where she had set it and did not move.
She let her eyes stay on Devin's without searching them, without softening at the corners, and she did not blink against the kitchen light spilling past his shoulder.
she watched his face without arranging hers.

value.name: Asha realizes she ceded final say
value.description: Asha understands that for the first time in two years she has given Devin the last say on one of her work decisions.
evidence: She understood, in the quiet, that she had handed him the last say on a piece of her work for the first time since he had come to her two years ago

value.name: Asha waits for Devin's decision
value.description: Asha remains in the doorway, prepared to see what Devin will do with the authority she has given him.
evidence: and that she would have to stand here and learn what he did with it.
the time it would take him to find his own answer inside it.

value.name: Devin remains silent and still
value.description: Devin keeps his hand on the door and does not move while the silence stretches between them.
evidence: The mug on the counter had gone quiet; the door under his hand did not shift.
Devin's hand stayed on the edge of the door, and for a long moment the only sound was the refrigerator cycling somewhere behind him.

value.name: Devin challenges Asha's memory
value.description: Devin finally speaks and says he remembers the situation differently, signaling disagreement with Asha's understanding.
evidence: Then he drew a short breath and said, "I remember it differently."

value.name: Asha refuses to open the argument
value.description: Asha does not respond or invite clarification, choosing not to give Devin an opening to soften his disagreement.
evidence: She did not move, did not ask which part, did not offer him the opening to soften what came next;

value.name: Asha lets the statement stand
value.description: Asha silently absorbs Devin's words and recognizes that his response carries further implications he does not yet need to spell out.
evidence: she only let the four words stand in the yellow square of kitchen light between them and understood, without needing him to say more, that
